SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 25416
Date ____ / ____

Copy for officer i/c, Special Branch

"A"
Misc. 116/34.        Central
                     April      30,      34.
1

Functioning of a detective from the Public
Safety Bureau in the Settlement.

At 12:15p.m. 30/4/34 Mr. Y.M. Cheng the Chief Clerk
of the Continental Bank Ltd at 28 Tientsin Road and resi-
ding at 82 Tsze Ts Loong of Keu Men Di, Nantae with the
assistance of C.P.W. 2128 brought to the Station one named
Wu Tseh Ching (吳澤卿) for creating a disturbance on the
premises of the above Bank.

From Mr. Y.M. Cheng it was learned that about 11:30
a.m. Wu approached him in the Bank and asked whether he
(Cheng) wrote the letter to Nanking Government containing information
re arrival of some communist to Shanghai. On receiving
negative answer Wu said that they are in possession of
that letter and on being asked that whom he meant by "they"
Wu stated that he was a detective attached to Special
Branch of Public Safety Bureau, but refused to produce
any documents of identification to that effect. Conse-
quently Y.M. Cheng refused to answer any of Wu's questions.
Then Wu said that "I will fix you in Nantae very soon".
This was said in such a manner that Y.M. Cheng was com-
pelled to refer the matter to the Police.

At the Station Wu produced his identification card
issued by the Public Safety Bureau proving that he was
honourably detective No. 316 attached to the Special
Branch of the Bureau.

He also stated that he went to the Continental Bank

特别科负责警官存副本

“A”
杂项 116/34.        中央
                     1934年      4月      30日，      34.
1

公共租界内公共安全局侦探的执法行为。

1934年4月30日下午12时15分，大陆银行有限公司（Continental Bank Ltd.）首席职员Y.M. Cheng先生（办公地址：天津路28号；居住地址：南市久门底子子弄82号）在巡捕C.P.W. 2128的协助下，将一名名为吴泽卿（Wu Tseh Ching）的男子带至警局，理由是该人在上述银行 premises 内滋事。

据Y.M. Cheng先生称，上午11时30分左右，吴进入银行找到他，询问他（Cheng）是否曾致信南京政府，信中涉及某些共产党人抵达上海的情报。得到否定回答后，吴声称他们持有该信件。当被问及“他们”指谁时，吴称自己是隶属于公共安全局特别科的侦探，但拒绝出示任何身份证明文件。因此，Y.M. Cheng拒绝回答吴的任何问题。随后吴说：“我很快就在南市收拾你。”其语气迫使Y.M. Cheng不得不将此事宜交予警方处理。

在警局，吴出示了由公共安全局签发的身份证，证明他是该局特别科荣誉侦探第316号。

他还陈述称，他去大陆银行

pages.en:
1/Chset No.2.

to interview Y.M. Cheng in the course of his enquiries re
the communistic movements and that order to do so, he
received from Mr. Liu Hwa i/c of the Special Branch of
the Public Safety Bureau.

He explained the case as follows:-
A letter was sent to Nanking by some one who signed
his name as Chang Yung Cheng residing at 52 Tse Ts Loong
of Keu Heu Di, Nantao informing the Authorities that
certain communist named Tong Tsing (唐精) recently
arrived in Shanghai from Kiangsu Province.

This morning Wu visited the writer's address in
Nantao and was informed that Y.M. Cheng could be seen in
The Continental Bank. Wu denied creating disturbance in
the Bank and also stated that he was not aware of the
procedure that all enquiries in the Settlement when
persons were to be interviewed must be made with the
assistance of the Police District concerned.

D.C. "A" was communicated with and instructed to
bring the matter to the notice of Mr. Liu Hwa and to
ask him to send some representative who may identify Wu
and to get all required particulars from Y.M. Cheng.

At about 4 p.m. one Chang Ching Tai detective
Inspector of the Public Safety Bureau arrived and carried
out all the necessary enquiries. At about 7 p.m. same
date Y.M. Cheng came again to the Station together with
a Mr. Tong Tsing a clerk employed by the Continental Bank
pages.zh:
1/张号2。

是为了就共产主义运动进行调查而约谈Y.M. Cheng，并称此举是奉公共安全局特别科负责人刘华（Liu Hwa）先生之命。

他对案情解释如下：-
有人以居住在南市久后底子子弄52号的张永成（Chang Yung Cheng）的名义向南京寄去一封信，向当局通报称，一名名为唐精（Tong Tsing）的共产党人最近从江苏省抵达上海。

当天上午，吴前往南市写信人的住址，得知可在大陆银行见到Y.M. Cheng。吴否认在银行内滋事，并声称他不知道在租界内进行涉及约谈人员的调查时，必须经由相关警区警方协助的程序规定。

已联系“A”区副督察，并指示其将此事宜提请刘华先生注意，要求其派遣代表前来辨认吴，并从Y.M. Cheng处获取所有必要详情。

下午4时许，公共安全局侦探督察张景泰（Chang Ching Tai）抵达，并进行了所有必要的调查。同日晚上7时许，Y.M. Cheng再次来到警局，同行的还有大陆银行职员唐精（Tong Tsing）先生，

pages.en:
1/Sheet No.3.

who was transferred from the Tientsin Branch about four
months ago. Tong Tsing's name was mentioned in the
letter as of a communist who had arrived in Shanghai.
The both men stated that they strongly suspected
one Tao Chi Yao being the writer of the letter and as
the reasons for their suspicions they gave the following
grounds that:-
(1) Tao Chi Yao was the only person amongst all
the staff with whom they both were on very bad terms (2)
The address of Y.N. Cheng mentioned in the letter could
be known only to some one in the Bank and (3) That to
Y.N. Cheng who saw the letter the handwriting appeared
to be very similar to that of Tao Chi Yao's.
They also informed the undersigned that if it would
be necessary they may supply the Police with Tao's
handwriting for comparison.
The letter in question had been shown to Det. Inspt.
Rees of Special Branch.

D.S Beloshenko has been
instructed to obtain specimen
of Tao Chi Yao's handwriting
for comparison if the
City Authority will lend
us the original letter

唐精约四个月前从天津分行调来。信中提到的抵达上海的共产党人即为唐精。
两人均表示，他们强烈怀疑陶继尧（Tao Chi Yao）是写信人，并列出了以下怀疑理由：-
(1) 陶继尧是所有员工中唯一与他们两人都关系极差的人 (2) 信中提到的Y.N. Cheng的地址只有银行内部人员才可能知晓，以及 (3) 见过信件的Y.N. Cheng认为，笔迹与陶继尧的非常相似。
他们还告知签署人，如有必要，他们可以向警方提供陶的笔迹样本以供比对。
涉案信件已向特别科侦探督察里斯（Rees）出示。

已指示D.S. Beloshenko

Copy for Officer i/c. Spl. Branch.

Bubbling Well

Saturday 24th March 1934.

ILLEGAL
FUNCTIONING.

（批：SI / Recorded / Who & when）

At about 2.30 p.m. on the 23-3-34, Motor Bus, license No.15199, driver No.166, was proceeding East along the Hungjao Road and when near Warren Road it collided with a public ricsha which was being plied in a haphazard manner on the road. The ricsha when struck turned over and one of the iron stands struck the coolie on the right heel causing a deep lacerated wound. No damage to vehicles. Members of the Bureau of Public Safety who were on the scene arrested the driver of the Bus and took him to the Peh Sing Ching Sub-Station. Inspector Chamberlain attended, and after communicating with Colonel Tan Bo Sheo and informing him that the accident had occurred on a Municipal Road, the driver was handed over and released at Bubbling Well Station after particulars of the accident had been obtained.
Ricsha coolie treated at the Red Cross Hospital but not detained.

ARMED ROBBERY.

At 7.25 p.m. on the 23-3-34, two men both armed with pistols entered the open front door of a rice shop situated at No.241 Annam Road, and after intimidating the inmates one of the robbers remained on guard over them whilst the other robber proceeded to the rear of the shop and stole $32.00 from the accountant's drawer. They then left by point of entry and proceeded South on Hardoon Road.
They were followed by two of the shop assistants who raised an alarm whereupon the robbers commenced to run and one of them discharged his pistol twice into the roadway without turning around. The assistants then give up the pursuit and the robbers made good their escape.
Reported at Station by telephone at 7.30 p.m. and three patries of Police who attended searched the streets in the vicinity without result.
Nearest Police to scene of robbery at Hardoon & Bubblingwell Roads, 150 yards away, did not see or hear anything unusual. Circulated and inquiries proceeding.
(For detailed report see Crime Register No.224).

PATROL
MOTOR CYCLES.

（批：签名/花押）

P.S.256 Race in charge of motor cycle B.26 patrolled all Extra Settlement Roads between 7-9 a.m. and 3-7 p.m. on the 23-3-34. No reports. No arrests.
P.S.353 Cuthush in charge of motor cycle B.31 patrolled Extra Settlement Roads West of the Railway line between 11 a.m.-3 p.m. and 7-11 p.m. on the 23-3-34. No reports. No arrests.
P.S.364 Halley in charge of motor cycle B.26 Patrolled Extra Settlement Roads East of the Railway Line between 11 a.m.-3 p.m. and 7-11 p.m. on the 23-3-34. No reports. No arrests.
P.S.370 Beaky in charge of motor cycle B.40 patrolled all Extra Settlement Roads between 11 p.m. the 23rd and 7 a.m. the 24th inst. No reports. No arrests.

SEARCH PARTY
PATROLS.

P.S.280 Beresovsky in charge of an armed party patrolled various roads and alleyways in the district between 8-8 p.m. on the 23-3-34 and reports having stopped and examined 4 motor cars, 6 ricshas and a number of pedestrians. No reports. No arrests.

静安寺

1934年3月24日，星期六。

非法
执法行为。

（批：SI / 已记录 / 何人及何时）

1934年3月23日下午2时30分左右，牌照号为15199、司机编号为166的公共汽车沿虹桥路向东行驶，当接近华伦路（Warren Road）时，与一辆在道路上随意行驶的人力车相撞。人力车被撞翻，其中一根铁支架击中车夫的右脚跟，造成严重的撕裂伤。车辆无损。现场在场的公共安全局成员逮捕了公交车司机，并将其带至北四川路分站。钱伯林（Chamberlain）督察到场，在与谭伯修（Tan Bo Sheo）上校沟通并告知事故发生在工部局道路后，在获取事故详情后，司机在静安寺警局被移交并释放。
人力车夫在红十字会医院接受治疗，未被拘留。

持械抢劫。

1934年3月23日晚上7时25分，两名均手持手枪的男子进入位于安南路241号的一家米店敞开的正门，在恐吓店内人员后，其中一名劫匪负责看守他们，另一名劫匪则前往店铺后部，从会计抽屉中窃取了32.00元。随后他们从进入点离开，沿哈同路（Hardoon Road）向南逃窜。
两名店员尾随其后并发出警报，劫匪随即开始奔跑，其中一人未回头便向路面开了两枪。店员随后放弃追赶，劫匪成功逃脱。
晚上7时30分通过电话向警局报告，三队警员到场并在附近街道进行搜索，但未果。
距离抢劫现场最近的警力位于哈同路与静安寺路交界处，相距150码，未看到或听到任何异常情况。已通缉，调查正在进行中。
（详细报告见犯罪登记册第224号）。

巡逻
摩托车。

（批：签名/花押）

警士256号 Race 负责驾驶B.26号摩托车，于1934年3月23日上午7时至9时及下午3时至7时期间，巡逻所有越界筑路区域道路。无报告。无逮捕。
警士353号 Cuthush 负责驾驶B.31号摩托车，于1934年3月23日上午11时至下午3时及晚上7时至11时期间，巡逻铁路线以西的越界筑路区域道路。无报告。无逮捕。
警士364号 Halley 负责驾驶B.26号摩托车，于1934年3月23日上午11时至下午3时及晚上7时至11时期间，巡逻铁路线以东的越界筑路区域道路。无报告。无逮捕。
警士370号 Beaky 负责驾驶B.40号摩托车，于本月23日晚上11时至24日上午7时期间，巡逻所有越界筑路区域道路。无报告。无逮捕。

Bubbling Well
Monday 5th Feb. 4.

At 11.30 p.m. on the 4-2-34, J. .C.1092 informed the station
by telephone that the Jinsei Police had arrested a Bus
Conductor and ricksha coolie for fighting on Bremen Road.
J.L. Myerscough proceeded to the 6th Division H.Q. and
there ascertained that a fight had occurred between Bus
Conductor No.8 and the ricksha coolie when the conductor
remonstrated with a number of coolies for causing annoyance
to passengers when leaving the bus.
Jinsei Police who were first on the scene, prevented
Jinsei Police from interfering and took both parties to the
6th Division Station where J.L. Myerscough asked that they
be handed over by the offence had occurred on a Municipal
Road. His request was refused by the Inspector in charge
who stated that the ricksha coolie would be fined $2.00 and
sentenced to 2 days detention for assaulting the conductor
who was allowed to go.

1934年2月5日，星期一。

1934年2月4日晚上11时30分，J.C.1092通过电话通知警局，日本警察（Jinsei Police）因在百老汇路（Bremen Road）打架逮捕了一名公交车售票员和一名人力车夫。J.L. Myerscough 前往第六分区总部，经查实，当售票员因一群车夫在下客时骚扰乘客而提出抗议时，8号公交车售票员与一名人力车夫发生了斗殴。
最先到达现场的日本警察阻止了其他日本警察介入，并将双方带至第六分区警局。J.L. Myerscough 要求因违法行为发生在工部局道路上而将人移交，但该要求被负责督察拒绝，该督察称人力车夫将被罚款2.00元，并因袭击售票员被判拘留2天，售票员则被允许离开。

Copy for Officer i/c. Spl. Branch.

Bubbling Well

Friday 2nd February 1934

At 9.35 a.m. on the 1-2-34, Mr. J. Burkley, P.M.C. reported at station that three of his coolies had been arrested by the Chapel Police.
Inspector Chamberlain attended and ascertained that the coolies had been arrested for dumping garbage at the rear of premises No.53 Great Western Road, Chinese territory, arrangements having been made between the owner of the premises, Dong Cheng Cycle Co. and the P.M.C. to fill in a large pool of water.
Colonel Tan De Sheo released the coolies, and requested that no more garbage be dumped until the Bureau of Sanitation, Shanghai City Government, had been communicated with.

At 6.30 a.m. on the 1-2-34, C.D.S. No.8, attached to the Bureau of Public Safety, came to the station with S.S.D. Court Warrant No.1242 and requested assistance to proceed to Lane 381, House 88 Hart Road, to arrest one named Kan Kyad Shuang, on a charge of embezzlement.
Necessary assistance rendered but the wanted person was not located. His son, Kan Can Kheo, aged 31, was found on the premises, and at the request of the B.P.S. (who stated that a warrant had been issued for his arrest on a charge of misappropriation) he was brought to the Station. The warrant No.1257 was later produced by the B.P.S. and the accused will appear before the S.S.D. Court this a.m. 2-2-34 when the B.P.S. will make an application for his extradition.

At 11.30 p.m. on the 1-2-34, a telephone message was received from the C.J.R. reporting that the ambulance had been called to No.466 Seymour Road.
Inquiries ascertained that at 10.30 p.m. on the 1-2-34 one Maud, Mrs. Karl Hombachik, Russian, aged 56, residing at the above address, returned home with her husband after visiting friends in the French Concession, and at 10.45 p.m. whilst about to retire she suddenly collapsed.
Efforts to restore her being unsuccessful, the C.J.R. Ambulance was called and removed her to the French Hospital where she was found to be dead on arrival.
In completion of final police her medical certificate, Dr. Lomovage, No.170 Bubbling Well Road, stating that she had been suffering from cancer for several years. (No death certificate issued).
Body removed to the Public Mortuary pending inquest being held on the 3rd inst.
(Station Reference No.300).

静安寺

1934年2月2日，星期五

1934年2月1日上午9时35分，公共马车公司（P.M.C.）J. Burkley先生向警局报告，称其三名苦力被教堂巡捕房逮捕。
张伯伦督察前往处理，经查实，这些苦力因在中国地界大西路53号房屋后方倾倒垃圾而被捕。该房屋业主董成自行车行（Dong Cheng Cycle Co.）与公共马车公司之间已达成协议，计划填平一处大水坑。
谭德少校（Colonel Tan De Sheo，音译）释放了这些苦力，并要求在联系上海市卫生局之前，不得再倾倒垃圾。

1934年2月1日上午6时30分，隶属于公安局的刑事侦缉队第8号探员持特区法院第1242号逮捕令来到警局，请求协助前往哈同路381弄88号，以挪用公款罪逮捕一名名为Kan Kyad Shuang（音译）的人。
警方提供了必要协助，但未找到被通缉者。在其住所内发现了其子Kan Can Kheo（音译），31岁。应公安局要求（公安局称已因其侵吞罪签发逮捕令），将其带至警局。随后公安局出示了第1257号逮捕令，被告将于1934年2月2日上午出庭特区法院，届时公安局将申请引渡。

1934年2月1日晚上11时30分，接到中央捕房电话报告，称救护车已被召往西摩路466号。
经查询获悉，1934年2月1日晚上10时30分，居住于上述地址的56岁俄国人卡尔·洪巴奇克夫人（Mrs. Karl Hombachik），名莫德（Maud），在探访法租界的朋友后与丈夫一同回家。晚上10时45分，在她准备就寝时突然昏倒。
由于抢救无效，遂呼叫中央捕房救护车将其送往法国医院，抵达时已确认死亡。
作为最终警务调查的一部分，其医疗证明书由静安寺路170号的Lomovage医生（音译）出具，称其患癌症已有数年。（未签发死亡证明）。
遗体已移送公共停尸房，等待于本月3日举行死因研讯。
（警局参考编号：300）。
